objects.description: Enumeration of error codes returned by the Verge consensus verification API. It reports success and specific failure reasons encountered during script verification. Both the tag name (vergeconsensus_error_t) and the typedef alias (vergeconsensus_error) refer to the same enum type.

functions.name: vergeconsensus_verify_script
functions.signature: int vergeconsensus_verify_script(const unsigned char* scriptPubKey, unsigned int scriptPubKeyLen, const unsigned char* txTo, unsigned int txToLen, unsigned int nIn, unsigned int flags, vergeconsensus_error* err)
functions.description: Verifies that input index nIn of the serialized transaction txTo correctly spends the provided scriptPubKey under the constraints indicated by flags. Returns 1 on successful validation, 0 otherwise. On completion, if err is not null, it is set to a vergeconsensus_error indicating success or the reason for failure. Use this variant only when the amount of the spent output is not required (i.e., when not verifying witness rules).
requirements: scriptPubKey must point to a buffer of length scriptPubKeyLen bytes containing the locking script (scriptPubKey) to be spent.
txTo must point to a buffer of length txToLen bytes containing a fully serialized transaction (network serialization).
nIn must be a valid input index into the transaction in txTo; if out of range, verification will fail and err may be set to vergeconsensus_ERR_TX_INDEX.
flags is a bitmask composed of vergeconsensus_SCRIPT_FLAGS_* values; invalid combinations may yield vergeconsensus_ERR_INVALID_FLAGS.

If flags includes vergeconsensus_SCRIPT_FLAGS_VERIFY_WITNESS, this function will fail with vergeconsensus_ERR_AMOUNT_REQUIRED; callers must use vergeconsensus_verify_script_with_amount instead when witness verification is requested.
err may be NULL; if non-NULL, it will be set to vergeconsensus_ERR_OK on success or an appropriate error code on failure.
Inputs must be well-formed; malformed txTo will fail with vergeconsensus_ERR_TX_DESERIALIZE or vergeconsensus_ERR_TX_SIZE_MISMATCH as applicable.

functions.name: vergeconsensus_verify_script_with_amount
functions.signature: int vergeconsensus_verify_script_with_amount(const unsigned char* scriptPubKey, unsigned int scriptPubKeyLen, int64_t amount, const unsigned char* txTo, unsigned int txToLen, unsigned int nIn, unsigned int flags, vergeconsensus_error* err)
functions.description: Verifies that input index nIn of the serialized transaction txTo correctly spends the provided scriptPubKey under the constraints indicated by flags, using the specified amount (satoshi-like base unit) of the output being spent. This variant is required for verification modes that need the spent amount (e.g., WITNESS). Returns 1 on success, 0 otherwise. If provided, err is set to a vergeconsensus_error describing the outcome.
requirements: scriptPubKey must point to a buffer of length scriptPubKeyLen bytes containing the locking script (scriptPubKey) to be spent.
amount is the value of the UTXO being spent by input nIn, in the protocol’s base unit; it must be the exact amount corresponding to that previous output when witness verification is enabled.
txTo must point to a buffer of length txToLen bytes containing a fully serialized transaction (network serialization).
nIn must be a valid input index into the transaction in txTo; if out of range, verification will fail and err may be set to vergeconsensus_ERR_TX_INDEX.
flags is a bitmask composed of vergeconsensus_SCRIPT_FLAGS_* values; invalid combinations may yield vergeconsensus_ERR_INVALID_FLAGS.
This function should be used whenever flags includes vergeconsensus_SCRIPT_FLAGS_VERIFY_WITNESS; using the non-amount variant in that case will fail with vergeconsensus_ERR_AMOUNT_REQUIRED.
err may be NULL; if non-NULL, it will be set to vergeconsensus_ERR_OK on success or an appropriate error code on failure.
Inputs must be well-formed; malformed txTo will fail with vergeconsensus_ERR_TX_DESERIALIZE or vergeconsensus_ERR_TX_SIZE_MISMATCH as applicable.

functions.name: vergeconsensus_version
functions.description: Returns the consensus verification API version supported by this library. Useful for feature detection and compatibility checks at runtime.
requirements: No arguments; callable at any time after the library is loaded.

endpoints.name: vergeconsensus_verify_script
vergeconsensus_verify_script_with_amount
vergeconsensus_version

data_types.description: A raw byte buffer containing a locking script (scriptPubKey) as used in Bitcoin/Bitcoin-derived chains (e.g., Verge). It consists of stack-based script opcodes and data pushes per the consensus Script language. Examples include P2PKH, P2SH, P2WPKH, P2WSH, and other standard or nonstandard scripts. The buffer is not text; it is a binary script sequence exactly as placed in transaction outputs.

A raw byte buffer containing a fully network-serialized transaction per Bitcoin-family consensus rules (version, inputs with prevouts, scriptSigs, sequences, outputs with values and scriptPubKeys, locktime; optionally witness data when applicable). This is binary data in the standard wire format, not textual JSON or hex, and must be complete and well-formed for successful deserialization.

generators.generator:
import struct, random

# This generator creates a binary buffer that packs two items back-to-back:
# 1) scriptPubKey blob (var with prefix length)
# 2) tx blob (var with prefix length)
# The fuzz stubs call FUZZ_PARAM_STR twice; many harnesses source both
# strings from the same seed buffer by splitting or cycling. Encoding
# both with explicit size headers allows common splitters to extract each
# blob deterministically. If the harness passes the whole buffer to one
# FUZZ_PARAM_STR call, it will still treat it as raw bytes.
#
# We produce valid Bitcoin-like (Verge-like) transaction bytes and a
# corresponding spendable scriptPubKey that matches the tx input's
# scriptSig, primarily covering P2PKH and P2WPKH-in-P2SH patterns. The
# transaction will be self-contained and well-formed for consensus
# deserialization without relying on external UTXO set (consensus API
# verifies script correctness only against provided scriptPubKey and
# provided amount when using _with_amount).

MAX_TOTAL = 4096

# CompactSize (Bitcoin varint)
def ser_compact_size(n: int) -> bytes:
    if n < 0xFD:
        return struct.pack('<B', n)
    if n <= 0xFFFF:
        return b"\xfd" + struct.pack('<H', n)
    if n <= 0xFFFFFFFF:
        return b"\xfe" + struct.pack('<I', n)
    return b"\xff" + struct.pack('<Q', n)

# Script building helpers

def op_push(data: bytes) -> bytes:
    l = len(data)
    if l <= 75:
        return struct.pack('B', l) + data
    elif l <= 255:
        return b"\x4c" + struct.pack('B', l) + data  # OP_PUSHDATA1
    elif l <= 65535:
        return b"\x4d" + struct.pack('<H', l) + data  # OP_PUSHDATA2
    else:
        return b"\x4e" + struct.pack('<I', l) + data  # OP_PUSHDATA3

OP_DUP = b"\x76"
OP_HASH160 = b"\xa9"
OP_EQUALVERIFY = b"\x88"
OP_CHECKSIG = b"\xac"
OP_EQUAL = b"\x87"
OP_0 = b"\x00"
OP_1 = b"\x51"

# Simple DER-like signature (not necessarily valid ECDSA, but structurally plausible)
def fake_der_sig(rng: random.Random) -> bytes:
    # Create simple DER sequence: 0x30 len 0x02 rlen r 0x02 slen s
    def mpi(nbytes):
        # ensure positive and no leading zero unless high bit set
        b = bytes(rng.getrandbits(8) for _ in range(nbytes))
        if len(b) == 0:
            b = b"\x01"
        if b[0] & 0x80:
            b = b"\x00" + b
        return b
    r = mpi(rng.randint(20, 32))
    s = mpi(rng.randint(20, 32))
    inner = b"\x02" + bytes([len(r)]) + r + b"\x02" + bytes([len(s)]) + s
    seq = b"\x30" + bytes([len(inner)]) + inner
    # append sighash type SIGHASH_ALL (1) optionally with forkid off
    sighash = bytes([rng.choice([1, 2, 3, 0x81, 0x82, 0x83])])
    return seq + sighash

# 33-byte compressed pubkey or 65-byte uncompressed

def fake_pubkey(rng: random.Random) -> bytes:
    if rng.random() < 0.7:
        return bytes([rng.choice([2, 3])]) + bytes(rng.getrandbits(8) for _ in range(32))
    else:
        return b"\x04" + bytes(rng.getrandbits(8) for _ in range(64))

# Hash160 placeholder (20 bytes); we don't compute real hashes to keep it simple

def fake_hash160(rng: random.Random) -> bytes:
    return bytes(rng.getrandbits(8) for _ in range(20))

# Build a standard P2PKH locking script for a given pubkey hash

def build_p2pkh_script(pkhash: bytes) -> bytes:
    return OP_DUP + OP_HASH160 + op_push(pkhash) + OP_EQUALVERIFY + OP_CHECKSIG

# Build a standard P2SH locking script for a given redeemScript hash

def build_p2sh_script(script_hash: bytes) -> bytes:
    return OP_HASH160 + op_push(script_hash) + OP_EQUAL

# Build scriptSig for P2PKH: <sig> <pubkey>

def build_p2pkh_scriptsig(sig: bytes, pubkey: bytes) -> bytes:
    return op_push(sig) + op_push(pubkey)

# Build P2WPKH nested in P2SH: scriptSig pushes redeem script 0 <20-byte>

def build_p2sh_p2wpkh_scriptsig(wpkh: bytes) -> bytes:
    redeem = OP_0 + op_push(wpkh)
    return op_push(redeem)

# Build a minimal witness stack for P2WPKH: [sig, pubkey]

def build_witness_stack(sig: bytes, pubkey: bytes) -> bytes:
    return b"\x02" + op_push(sig) + op_push(pubkey)  # 2 stack items

# Serialize a transaction in Bitcoin-like wire format (non-segwit or segwit)

def serialize_tx(version: int, vin: list, vout: list, locktime: int, witness_stacks=None) -> bytes:
    # vin: list of dicts {txid, vout, scriptSig, sequence}
    # vout: list of dicts {value, scriptPubKey}
    segwit = witness_stacks is not None and any(witness_stacks)
    res = struct.pack('<i', version)
    if segwit:
        res += b"\x00\x01"  # marker, flag
    # inputs
    res += ser_compact_size(len(vin))
    for txin in vin:
        res += txin['txid'][::-1]  # little-endian txid
        res += struct.pack('<I', txin['vout'])
        res += op_push(txin['scriptSig']) if len(txin['scriptSig']) < 0x4c or True else b""  # use canonical push
        res += struct.pack('<I', txin['sequence'])
    # outputs
    res += ser_compact_size(len(vout))
    for txo in vout:
        res += struct.pack('<q', txo['value'])
        spk = txo['scriptPubKey']
        res += op_push(spk)
    # witness
    if segwit:
        for w in witness_stacks:
            if w is None:
                res += b"\x00"
            else:
                res += w
    res += struct.pack('<I', locktime)
    return res

# Build a coherent tx and matching scriptPubKey for input 0.

def build_case(rng: random.Random) -> tuple[bytes, bytes]:
    # Choose a template
    tpl = rng.choices(['p2pkh', 'p2sh_p2wpkh', 'p2pkh_multivout', 'p2pkh_twoin'], weights=[4, 3, 2, 2])[0]

    # Common fake prevout
    prev_txid = bytes(rng.getrandbits(8) for _ in range(32))
    prev_vout = rng.randrange(0, 5)

    version = rng.choice([1, 2])
    locktime = rng.randrange(0, 500000)

    sequence = rng.choice([0xFFFFFFFF, 0xFFFFFFFE, rng.getrandbits(32)])

    if tpl == 'p2pkh':
        pubkey = fake_pubkey(rng)
        sig = fake_der_sig(rng)
        h160 = fake_hash160(rng)
        spk = build_p2pkh_script(h160)
        scriptSig = build_p2pkh_scriptsig(sig, pubkey)
        vin = [{
            'txid': prev_txid,
            'vout': prev_vout,
            'scriptSig': scriptSig,
            'sequence': sequence,
        }]
        vout = [{
            'value': rng.randrange(0, 5_0000_0000),  # up to 5 XVG in satoshis-like
            'scriptPubKey': spk,
        }]
        tx = serialize_tx(version, vin, vout, locktime)
        return spk, tx

    if tpl == 'p2sh_p2wpkh':
        pubkey = fake_pubkey(rng)
        sig = fake_der_sig(rng)
        wpkh = fake_hash160(rng)
        redeem_hash = wpkh  # HASH160(redeem) would be Hash160(0 <20>), we approximate with wpkh
        spk = build_p2sh_script(redeem_hash)
        scriptSig = build_p2sh_p2wpkh_scriptsig(wpkh)
        vin = [{
            'txid': prev_txid,
            'vout': prev_vout,
            'scriptSig': scriptSig,
            'sequence': sequence,
        }]
        vout = [{
            'value': rng.randrange(0, 10_0000_0000),
            'scriptPubKey': spk,
        }]
        witness = [build_witness_stack(sig, pubkey)]
        tx = serialize_tx(version, vin, vout, locktime, witness_stacks=witness)
        return spk, tx

    if tpl == 'p2pkh_multivout':
        pubkey = fake_pubkey(rng)
        sig = fake_der_sig(rng)
        h160 = fake_hash160(rng)
        spk0 = build_p2pkh_script(h160)
        scriptSig = build_p2pkh_scriptsig(sig, pubkey)
        vin = [{
            'txid': prev_txid,
            'vout': prev_vout,
            'scriptSig': scriptSig,
            'sequence': sequence,
        }]
        vout = []
        for _ in range(rng.randint(2, 4)):
            kind = rng.choice(['p2pkh', 'p2sh'])
            if kind == 'p2pkh':
                spk_out = build_p2pkh_script(fake_hash160(rng))
            else:
                spk_out = build_p2sh_script(fake_hash160(rng))
            vout.append({'value': rng.randrange(0, 20_0000_0000), 'scriptPubKey': spk_out})
        tx = serialize_tx(version, vin, vout, locktime)
        return spk0, tx

    # tpl == 'p2pkh_twoin'
    pubkey0 = fake_pubkey(rng)
    sig0 = fake_der_sig(rng)
    h160_0 = fake_hash160(rng)
    spk0 = build_p2pkh_script(h160_0)
    scriptSig0 = build_p2pkh_scriptsig(sig0, pubkey0)

    pubkey1 = fake_pubkey(rng)
    sig1 = fake_der_sig(rng)
    scriptSig1 = build_p2pkh_scriptsig(sig1, pubkey1)

    vin = [
        {'txid': prev_txid, 'vout': prev_vout, 'scriptSig': scriptSig0, 'sequence': sequence},
        {'txid': bytes(rng.getrandbits(8) for _ in range(32)), 'vout': rng.randrange(0, 3), 'scriptSig': scriptSig1, 'sequence': sequence},
    ]
    vout = [
        {'value': rng.randrange(0, 15_0000_0000), 'scriptPubKey': build_p2pkh_script(fake_hash160(rng))},
        {'value': rng.randrange(0, 15_0000_0000), 'scriptPubKey': build_p2sh_script(fake_hash160(rng))},
    ]
    tx = serialize_tx(version, vin, vout, locktime)
    return spk0, tx


def pack_two_blobs(spk: bytes, tx: bytes, rng: random.Random) -> bytes:
    # Sometimes provide only spk or only tx to exercise stub splitting behavior
    mode = rng.choices(['both', 'only_spk', 'only_tx'], weights=[6, 1, 2])[0]
    if mode == 'only_spk':
        blob = ser_compact_size(len(spk)) + spk
    elif mode == 'only_tx':
        blob = ser_compact_size(len(tx)) + tx
    else:
        blob = ser_compact_size(len(spk)) + spk + ser_compact_size(len(tx)) + tx
    return blob


def generate(seed: int) -> bytes:
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    spk, tx = build_case(rng)
    buf = pack_two_blobs(spk, tx, rng)
    if len(buf) > MAX_TOTAL:
        buf = buf[:MAX_TOTAL]
    return buf
